# PCF BATTLE

> Powerchair Floorball Battle is an international powerchair floorball tournament in Leuven, Belgium.

Powerchair Floorball Battle brings teams together for high-level international powerchair floorball competition in an exciting arena atmosphere.

## Tournament

- [Homepage](https://pcfbattle.be/): Official PCF BATTLE website and tournament overview.
- [About the tournament](https://pcfbattle.be/about): Tournament format, venue, dates and practical information.
- [Tournament schedule](https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/schedule): Scheduled matches and court times.
- [Live matches](https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/live): Live and upcoming tournament matches.
- [Standings](https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/standings): Current group and tournament standings.
- [Brackets](https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/brackets): Knockout-stage bracket and match progression.
- [Participating teams](https://pcfbattle.be/about#teams): Teams taking part in the tournament.

## Information

- [Frequently asked questions](https://pcfbattle.be/faq): Answers about the tournament and participation.
- [Accessibility statement](https://pcfbattle.be/accessibility): Accessibility information for visitors.
- [Privacy policy](https://pcfbattle.be/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Terms and conditions](https://pcfbattle.be/terms): Registration and participation terms.

## Optional

- [Contact](mailto:hello@pcfbattle.be): Contact the PCF BATTLE organisers by email.
